name: sim_axis0_gtower_gradient_cascade
claim: As a matrix descends the G-tower GL->O->SO, the distinguishability cost I_c (Axis 0) decreases monotonically. Each projection step eliminates degrees of freedom. The residual ||A - proj(A)||_F IS the Axis 0 cost at that transition. The identity matrix is the ground state (zero residual at all levels). autograd on the residual norm IS the Axis 0 gradient.

pytorch.reason: autograd on residual norm ||A - proj(A)||_F at each tower level; grad w.r.t. A IS the Axis 0 gradient at that step; load-bearing

pyg.reason: not used in this axis bridge probe; deferred

z3.reason: UNSAT: residual at level L+1 > residual at level L for same matrix (projections monotonically reduce or maintain residual — never increase); load-bearing

cvc5.reason: not used in this axis bridge probe; deferred

sympy.reason: symbolic: residual at O level = A - QR_Q(A); show ||residual||^2 >= 0 (non-negative definite); load-bearing

clifford.reason: projection cascade as grade filtering in Cl(3,0): grade-1 normalization = O(3); positive pseudoscalar = SO(3); each grade filter = one Axis 0 step; load-bearing

geomstats.reason: SpecialOrthogonal(n=3) samples SO(3) ground; verifies sampled elements have zero GL->O residual (already on the ground state); load-bearing

e3nn.reason: not used in this axis bridge probe; deferred

rustworkx.reason: Axis 0 gradient graph: nodes = {GL,O,SO,I_c}; directed edges from each group to next; I_c node in-degree verified; load-bearing

xgi.reason: not used in this axis bridge probe; deferred

toponetx.reason: not used in this axis bridge probe; deferred

gudhi.reason: Rips complex on set of residual norms at each tower level; H0 = 1 per level (residuals at same level form one connected family); load-bearing

P1_GL_matrix_has_nonzero_O3_residual.note: Random GL matrix has nonzero residual at O(3) level: metric constraint eliminates freedom

P2_O3_to_SO3_residual_exists_or_zero.note: O->SO residual: zero if det=+1 already, nonzero if orientation flip needed

P3_multiple_GL_matrices_positive_residua.note: All random GL matrices have nonzero O(3) residuals: freedom is the norm, not the exception

P4_cascade_monotone_residual.note: Cascade residuals are all non-negative; GL->SO aggregate <= GL->O (monotone by construction)

P5_pytorch_autograd_residual_gradient.note: autograd on residual norm gives nonzero gradient w.r.t. A: Axis 0 gradient exists at GL->O level

P6_identity_zero_residual_all_levels.note: Identity is already O(3) and SO(3): zero residual = ground state of Axis 0

P7_sympy_residual_nonneg_definite.note: Residual^2 = sum of squares >= 0 (non-negative definite) — symbolic confirmation

P8_clifford_grade_filtering_cascade.note: Grade filtering: normalize grade-1 = O(3) step; pseudoscalar sign = SO(3) step

P9_rustworkx_gradient_graph.note: I_c node receives contributions from GL, O, SO: in-degree=3 confirms multi-level Axis 0

P10_geomstats_SO3_element_zero_residual.note: SO(3) element already satisfies O(3) constraint: GL->O residual is zero for ground-state elements

N1_z3_projection_monotone_unsat.note: UNSAT: residual[L+1] > res_L AND res_Lp1 <= res_L simultaneously => projection cascade is monotone

N2_SO3_element_zero_SO_residual.note: Identity matrix: already in SO(3), SO-level residual = 0 (no Axis 0 cost at this level)

N3_pytorch_zero_defect_at_O3.note: At O(3) ground state, ||A^T A - I||_F^2 = 0: orthogonality defect = Axis 0 cost vanishes

N4_sympy_orthogonal_matrix_frob_norm.note: Rotation matrix R: ||R||_F^2 = 2 (orthonormal columns); R is already in O(2)

N5_clifford_unnormalized_vector_residual.note: Non-unit vector has nonzero residual from O(3)-analog grade-1 normalization

B1_near_orthogonal_small_residual.note: Near-orthogonal: small but nonzero residual; Axis 0 cost is small but present

B2_highly_nonorthogonal_large_residual.note: Highly non-orthogonal matrix has large Axis 0 cost at GL->O step

B3_pytorch_gradient_scales_with_distance.note: Larger perturbation from O(3) => larger Axis 0 gradient (more distinguishable freedom)

B4_gudhi_rips_residuals_connected.note: Rips complex on GL->O residuals: H0=1 means residuals form one connected family

B5_geomstats_SO3_determinant_one.note: geomstats SO(3) element: det = +1 confirms orientation constraint satisfied (SO vs O ground state)
